name: Every Ember-spending Pyromancer ability names the Ember in its tooltip (#6530)
contract: #6530: Explode, Flames of Neltharion and Echo of Nozdormu spend an Ember like Blaze but their tooltips never say so, and the same is true of Ignis Ultimatus, Roaring Pyre, Phoenix Dive and Firestorm. AscensionCustomResourceData.h ResourceCostRules is the authority on the cost: every row for class 24 with ResourceSpellId 807533 (the Ember aura) and ResourceConsumption::Fixed makes the cast spend one stack, while ResourceConsumption::None rows (Ember Touch and friends) only require it, and AscensionCompat applies exactly that with ModifyAuraStacks(-Amount). Blaze's client DBC description already opens with the conditional $?a807533[|cffff7f7f][|cffff3232]Consumes 1 Ember|r line; the other spenders do not. The client's own Spell.dbc cannot be edited from this repository, so the fix publishes each rank's unchanged DBC text with Blaze's exact prefix in coa_client_spell_description, which is baked into the client's spell rows. This scenario reads the client rows: each listed spell id must carry "Consumes 1 Ember" somewhere in its row payload, and the control row 500639 (Runeshroud, published by the same table) must still carry its own text and must not gain the Ember line. It then casts the three reported abilities with one Ember aura fixtured to show the text they now carry is true: each cast drops the 807533 stacks to zero. Expected before the SQL: no row for any of the 34 ids carries the cost line (row 500639 proves the client rows are read). Expected after: every row carries it and every cast spends the Ember.
